profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Architecture | FinTech | DevOps | Platform Engineering | Developer Productivity
profile.summary: I am a senior Software Developer with over 20 years of experience in all the phases of the software development lifecycle. I have over ten years of experience managing high-performing teams in the following areas: DevOps, CI/CD, Automation, Frameworks, Microservices, Infrastructure as Code for Cloud, and On-Prem. I specialize in improving the organization's performance by designing and creating processes, architectures, tools, and platforms that favor automation and standardization to scale knowledge transfer, reduce operational costs, and maintain compliance in highly regulated environments..

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Architecture · Cloud-Native Architecture · Communication · Scalability

positions.title: Senior Manager CI/CD Pipelines Team
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Strong management experience leading small, mid to large sized teams across Americas region
• Highly successful leading across hybrid and a-synch setups, involving multiple time zones,
language and cultural differences to foster strong team collaboration.
• Seasoned in end-to-end performance management, individual, team and stakeholder feedback,
corrective actions and budgetary decisions.
• Deep M&A experience leading engineering teams through acquisitions and executing transition
run books, overseeing technical, business and employee engagement deliverables.
• Created fully automated, flexible, and auditable CI/CD pipelines for libraries, binaries, and
applications written in Groovy, Java, Node.js, Go, and Python.
• Reduced the average time to take one line of code from feature to production from two weeks to
under one day.
• Reduced the time to configure a supported artifact's CI/CD lifecycle from one week to less than
five minutes.
• Reduced the average of manual touchpoints required to validate a supported artifact from fifty
to three.
• Reduced the costs of the CI controller fleet by over 30% by collapsing over 2,000 instances to
less than 10.
• Reduced the time for support requests from 2+ days to less than one hour by introducing
Documentation as Code practices and automated Slack workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Distributed Team Management · Scrum · Go (Programming Language) · Gradle · Productivity Improvement · DevOps · Agile Methodologies · Shell Scripting · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Maven · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · Groovy · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Product Development · Project Management · Coaching & Mentoring · Grade · Node.js · Java · Spring Boot · Jenkins · Signalfx · Splunk

positions.title: Senior Manager Developer Productivity
positions.description:
• Broad site leadership responsibilities, including sitting on Guatemala management council, overseeing DE&I, engagement and facilities decisions growing from 30 to 150+ employees.
•  Responsible for the Developer Productivity organization, including the CI/CD, Frameworks, and
 Enterprise Applications teams.
• Created a test-driven Jenkins Pipeline development framework that allowed my teams to write fully automated, flexible, extendible, and auditable CI/CD Pipelines.
• Created CI/CD pipelines for libraries, binaries, and applications written in Groovy, Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Android, IOS, Bash, Docker, RPM, Puppet, Ansible, Packer, and Terraform.
• Designed a cloud-agnostic three-layer architecture for Terraform that allowed Xoom to migrate their production workload from AWS to On-Prem and from On-Prem to GCP.
• Introduced and led the adoption of Docker as a way to scale the Lifecycle of the Microservice fleet.
• Provided the path to transition from a Monolith to a Microservice architecture by developing a convention-over-configuration process that allowed an application to be deployed to all environments (on-prem, AWS, GCP) without any configuration.
• Created desktop automation tools that allowed microservice developers to attain complete environment alignment with QA and Production.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Managed the integration of the cloud-native BlueKite infrastructure into the on-prem Xoom infrastructure.

positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
Helped co-found the financial startup Blue Kite (later to be acquired by Xoom). Responsible for overall
system architecture, native cloud deployment strategy (AWS), CI/CD, and developer productivity.

* Created a developer-friendly framework and DSL, allowing Blue Kite developers to easily
maintain integrations with Banks, Utilities, and other vendors.
* Used Puppet and CloudFormation to maintain all our AWS infrastructure via the Immutable
Infrastructure principles.
* Supported platform operations, focusing on system health, monitoring, and incident response.
Developed and maintained CI/CD workflows (CircleCI, Capistrano), facilitating rapid and reliable
code deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: AWS · PHP Applications · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · Capistrano · Nginx · SSL VPN · Puppet · AWS CloudFormation

projects.title: Bill Payments Platform
projects.description:
I am responsible for developing the web platform app.bluekite.com which makes
the balance inquiry and utility payments in Guatemala (Egssa, Energuate, Claro),
Mexico (energy Power, Telmex, Water Service), El Salvador (energy Power, Tigo).

projects.title: Plataforma Virtual para la Transparencia
projects.description: Es una ventanilla única para facilitar la gestión electrónica de solicitudes de información pública, como apoyo al cumplimiento de la Ley de Acceso a la Información Pública y los convenios suscritos para el gobierno abierto.
